### 📥 Install

Download the installer for your platform from the assets below:

| Platform | File |
|----------|------|
| 🪟 Windows | `baker-link-env_X.Y.Z_x64-setup.exe` |
| 🍎 macOS   | `baker-link-env_X.Y.Z_aarch64.dmg` / `baker-link-env_X.Y.Z_x64.dmg` |

> **macOS users:** If you see a "Damaged" error, run:
> ```sh
> xattr -d com.apple.quarantine "/Applications/Baker link. Env.app"
> ```
